title: Six Paths Rasenshuriken
body:
Syntax: perform six paths rasenshuriken <target>

Description: Hurl a Six Paths-enhanced Rasenshuriken against one target, dealing heavy chakra damage with a chance to weaken it. Reincarnate chakra supplies this technique's nature requirement. Base damage: 1509-1789. 40% chance to inflict weakened. Unlocks at level 75 only for Ashura reincarnations of any combat class. Requires your Six Paths mode active. Train and use the technique to increase its mastery. Costs 110 Chakra and 10 Stamina; 24 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
